title_en: Come on, a Sign on the Scales
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Line 1 'шана мана на кантарот' is unclear (possibly a nonsense or dialect phrase); my reading is 'a sign/mark on the scales'. Names with -инче (Шулинче, Малинче, Новинче) read as nicknames or surnames of makers; my reading.

words_to_learn.en: in the middle of the village

lines.en: Come on, a sign, a mark on the scales,

lines.cyr: да ме бараш Веле зад амбарот
lines.lat: da me baraš Vele zad ambarot
lines.en: look for me, Vele, behind the granary,

lines.cyr: ајде да ми дојдиш на Велигден
lines.lat: ajde da mi dojdiš na Veligden
lines.en: come on, come to me at Easter,
on Easter, Vele, the third day.
Come on, dance a dance with me,

lines.cyr: едно оро Веле на сред село
lines.lat: edno oro Vele na sred selo
lines.en: a dance, Vele, in the middle of the village,

lines.cyr: ајде и да умрам не ми е жал
lines.lat: ajde i da umram ne mi e žal
lines.en: come on, even if I die I do not regret it,

lines.cyr: се' што носам Веле, се' е твое.
lines.lat: se' što nosam Vele, se' e tvoe.
lines.en: everything I wear, Vele, is yours.
is from Pande, Vele, little Shulinche,
come on, the embroidered little jacket
is from Smile, Vele, little Maline.
Come on, the velvet little basket
is from Sandre, Vele, little Novinche,

lines.cyr: ајде и да умрам не ми е жал
lines.lat: ajde i da umram ne mi e žal
lines.en: come on, even if I die I do not regret it,

lines.cyr: се' што носам Веле, се' е твое.
lines.lat: se' što nosam Vele, se' e tvoe.
lines.en: everything I wear, Vele, is yours.
